categories.description: Primary tumor cannot be assessed.
No evidence of primary tumor.
Carcinoma in situ. Serializes the Tis (DCIS) and Tis (Paget) variants together; the underlying parenchymal disease, if any, is categorized by its own T value with Paget disease noted separately.
Tumor <= 1 mm in greatest dimension.
Tumor <= 20 mm in greatest dimension.
Tumor > 1 mm but <= 5 mm in greatest dimension (round measurements > 1.0–1.9 mm to 2 mm).
Tumor > 5 mm but <= 10 mm in greatest dimension.
Tumor > 10 mm but <= 20 mm in greatest dimension.
Tumor > 20 mm but <= 50 mm in greatest dimension.
Tumor > 50 mm in greatest dimension.
Tumor of any size with direct extension to the chest wall and/or to the skin (ulceration or macroscopic nodules); invasion of the dermis alone does not qualify as T4.
Extension to the chest wall; invasion or adherence to pectoralis muscle in the absence of invasion of chest wall structures does not qualify as T4.
Ulceration and/or ipsilateral macroscopic satellite nodules and/or edema (including peau d'orange) of the skin that does not meet the criteria for inflammatory carcinoma.
Both T4a and T4b are present.
Inflammatory carcinoma.

notes.tis_variants: AJCC distinguishes Tis (DCIS) -- ductal carcinoma in situ -- from Tis (Paget) -- Paget disease of the nipple NOT associated with invasive carcinoma and/or DCIS in the underlying parenchyma. Both share the same Tis category code in this model.
notes.lcis_removed: Lobular carcinoma in situ (LCIS) is a benign entity and is removed from TNM staging.

categories.description: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed (e.g., previously removed).
No regional lymph node metastases. In pathological staging this includes pN0(i+) (isolated tumor cells only) and pN0(mol+) (positive RT-PCR molecular findings, no ITCs detected).
Micrometastases (approximately 200 cells, larger than 0.2 mm, but none larger than 2.0 mm).

Clinical (cN1): metastases to movable ipsilateral Level I, II axillary lymph node(s). Pathological (pN1): micrometastases, or 1–3 axillary nodes, and/or clinically negative internal mammary nodes with sentinel-node mets.
Pathological only: metastases in 1–3 axillary lymph nodes, at least one deposit larger than 2.0 mm.
Pathological only: metastases in ipsilateral internal mammary sentinel nodes, excluding ITCs.
Pathological only: pN1a and pN1b combined.

Clinical: ipsilateral Level I, II axillary nodes clinically fixed or matted, or ipsilateral internal mammary nodes in the absence of axillary mets. Pathological: 4–9 axillary nodes, or positive ipsilateral internal mammary nodes by imaging in the absence of axillary mets.
Clinical: ipsilateral Level I, II axillary nodes fixed to one another (matted) or to other structures. Pathological: metastases in 4–9 axillary nodes (>= one deposit > 2.0 mm).

Clinical: metastases only in ipsilateral internal mammary nodes in the absence of axillary mets. Pathological: clinically detected internal mammary nodes with or without microscopic confirmation, axillary nodes negative.

Clinical: ipsilateral infraclavicular (Level III axillary) nodes; or ipsilateral internal mammary plus Level I/II axillary; or ipsilateral supraclavicular nodes. Pathological: >= 10 axillary nodes, or infraclavicular, or internal mammary plus axillary, or supraclavicular.
Clinical: ipsilateral infraclavicular lymph node(s). Pathological: >= 10 axillary nodes (>= one deposit > 2.0 mm) or metastases to infraclavicular nodes.
Clinical: ipsilateral internal mammary and axillary node(s). Pathological: pN1a or pN2a in the presence of cN2b (positive internal mammary nodes by imaging).
Metastases in ipsilateral supraclavicular lymph node(s).

notes.pn0_variants: Pathological pN0(i+) (isolated tumor cells, <= 0.2 mm) and pN0(mol+) (RT-PCR positive, no ITCs) both serialize to N0 in this model. They behave identically for stage-group lookup; record them at the data-entry layer if needed.
notes.pn_only: N1a, N1b, and N1c are defined only in the pathological (pN) axis; clinical cN does not subdivide N1.

suffixes.description: Confirmation by FNA or core needle biopsy.

categories.description: No clinical or radiographic evidence of distant metastases.

Distant metastases. Clinical cM1 means detected by clinical and radiographic means; pathological pM1 means any histologically proven distant metastasis, or non-regional nodal metastasis > 0.2 mm. Both serialize to M1 here; the c/p prefix is carried on the Classification axis.

notes.cM0_isolated: cM0(i+) -- no clinical/radiographic mets but tumor cells <= 0.2 mm detected in circulating blood, marrow, or non-regional nodal tissue in an asymptomatic patient -- is staged as M0 in this model.
notes.cm_pm_prefix: AJCC distinguishes cM1 (clinical detection) from pM1 (pathologic detection). This model encodes the prefix on the Classification axis (c vs p) rather than splitting M into cM1/pM1 literals.

categories.description: Anatomic stage group: TNM-only grouping, biomarkers and grade are not consulted. Use when biomarker status is unavailable, or when comparison with historical anatomic staging is needed.
Clinical Prognostic stage group: stage assigned from imaging, biopsy, and clinical exam, incorporating Grade + HER2/ER/PR status. cM categories indicate imaging-based metastasis assessment.

Pathological Prognostic stage group: stage assigned from the surgically resected specimen with histologic review, incorporating Grade + HER2/ER/PR status. pM categories require microscopic confirmation of distant metastasis.

notes.her2_equivocal: AJCC notes that Equivocal HER2 should be treated as Negative for Clinical Prognostic Stage Grouping. This model does NOT auto-coerce -- pass HER2 = Negative if the IHC/ISH cascade ended Equivocal. An Equivocal value will return UNSTAGEABLE.
notes.oncotype_gap: AJCC defines a Pathological-only exception: T1/T2 N0 M0 HER2- ER+ with Oncotype DX Score < 11 maps to IA regardless of grade. This model does NOT carry an OncotypeDX axis, so the exception is not applied automatically.

categories.description: Classification determined during or after the application of initial multimodal (neoadjuvant) therapy.
No neoadjuvant therapy preceded this assessment.

notes.matching: For breast AJCC 8 the stage table is identical regardless of DescY; the field is recorded for clinical context but does not affect the stage outcome.

categories.description: Recurrent tumor classification, assigned when the tumor is staged after a disease-free interval.
Not a recurrent tumor in this assessment.

notes.matching: For breast AJCC 8 the stage table is identical regardless of DescR; the field is recorded for clinical context but does not affect the stage outcome.

categories.description: Multiple synchronous primary tumors at the same anatomic site.
Single primary tumor.

notes.matching: For breast AJCC 8 the stage table is identical regardless of DescM; the field is recorded for clinical context but does not affect the stage outcome.

categories.description: Grade cannot be assessed.
Low combined histologic grade (favorable); Scarff-Bloom-Richardson (SBR) score of 3–5 points.
Intermediate combined histologic grade (moderately favorable); SBR score of 6–7 points.
High combined histologic grade (unfavorable); SBR score of 8–9 points.
HER2 positive by current IHC/ISH cascade.
HER2 negative by current IHC/ISH cascade.
HER2 status equivocal. AJCC: treat as Negative for Clinical Prognostic Stage Grouping (data-entry layer must apply this coercion; this model returns UNSTAGEABLE for Equivocal).
HER2 status not determined or not available.

notes.her2_equivocal_in_breast: Per AJCC 8, Equivocal HER2 is treated as Negative for Clinical Prognostic Stage Grouping. This model does NOT auto-apply the coercion -- callers must pass Negative when the cascade ended Equivocal.

categories.description: ER positive.
ER negative.
ER equivocal. Not handled by the AJCC stage tables; query will return UNSTAGEABLE.
ER status not determined or not available.
PR positive.
PR negative.
PR equivocal. Not handled by the AJCC stage tables; query will return UNSTAGEABLE.
PR status not determined or not available.
